label: Opening range high (30m)
gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day's first 30 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

label: Opening range low (30m)
gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day's first 30 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

label: IB extension up (1.5×)
gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance high plus 0.5 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB low reaches 1.5× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

label: IB extension down (1.5×)
gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance low minus 0.5 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB high reaches 1.5× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

label: IB extension up (2×)
gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance high plus 1 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB low reaches 2× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

label: IB extension down (2×)
gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance low minus 1 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB high reaches 2× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

label: Swing high (fractal 2/2)
gloss: the high of the most recent swing high — at or above the 2 highs before it and strictly above the 2 after it (Pine's ta.pivothigh tie rule) — published from the bar that completes its right side and held until the next swing high, or until it leaves reach

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Swing low (fractal 2/2)
gloss: the low of the most recent swing low — at or below the 2 lows before it and strictly below the 2 after it (Pine's ta.pivotlow tie rule) — published from the bar that completes its right side and held until the next swing low, or until it leaves reach

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Swing high age (bars)

label: Swing structure
gloss: the most recent decided swing pivot (2 bars each side) against the previous pivot on its own side: HH or LH for a swing high (an equal high is LH), HL or LL for a swing low (an equal low is HL), none when no comparable pair is in reach — a state held between pivots, not an event

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Internal structure break (internal 5, swing 50)
gloss: the internal structure's break on this bar — BOS when the close crosses its latest uncrossed level with the bias, CHoCH against it — over pivots of length 5, unless the level is also the swing level of length 50; absent on a bar with no break — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent until the bars read prove it (both sides decided and a break seen), so a long swing length reads absent on most bars

swingLength.description: The swing structure’s pivot length, each side: a swing pivot is decided this many closed bars after it.

confluenceFilter.description: Whether an internal structure break also needs LuxAlgo’s confluence bar test.
